meta.access_policy: ATTENTION: AGENTS MUST ONLY READ OR OPERATE THIS TEMPLATE THROUGH THE xc-orchestration-author SKILL AND ITS PUBLIC COMMANDS. DO NOT OPEN, SUMMARIZE, EDIT, PATCH, OR REFORMAT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.

node.title: Prepare new feature
node.instructions: Read the project bridge, create the run through xc-create-run, select an explicit feature ID, and create its empty directory through xc-feature.
node.deliverables: An authoritative run directory and empty managed feature directory.
node.acceptance: The context Git worktree is independent, the feature ID is explicit, and no baseline document exists outside document evolution.

node.title: Approve feature baseline
node.instructions: Present the accepted contract, feature solution, verification baseline, and run solution. Record approval or requested revision through the runtime.
node.deliverables: A recorded approval decision or follow-up document-evolution nodes.
node.acceptance: The feature baseline is approved or the tree contains explicit revision and review work.

node.title: Finalize new feature run
node.instructions: Confirm the result, feature baseline provenance, declared artifacts, and validation evidence, then close the run.
node.deliverables: A completed, failed, or blocked run with durable result evidence.
node.acceptance: The runtime tree and declared context artifacts accurately represent the outcome.
